entry.title: TouchEQ 8 0.1.3
entry.summary: **First release: please test and report back.** 8-band parametric EQ for standalone MPCs with a live curve and spectrum analyser. Pick a band (1-8) and drag its point on the graph; every band is one row of four Q-Links (Freq, Gain, Q, Type). ### Which file | File | For | |---|---| | `TouchEQ-8-0.1.3-mpc-sdk.zip` | **Copy by hand.** Unzip, put the folder `GreasyCratez - VST - TouchEQ 8` in `VST2 Plugins` at the root of an MPC drive, restart. One folder for every model. | | `TouchEQ-8-0.1.3-mpc-ar
